1. Call get_nearest_airport_by_city(location="Rivermist") -> gives e.g., "RMV"? Not sure. We'll see output.

Then call get_flight_cost(travel_from=<airport>, travel_to="JFK", travel_date="2024-12-01", travel_class="first").

Return result.

Let's proceed.
